description: This file defines the interface ICalcDisplay, which specifies callback methods for updating the calculator display, handling errors, expression tokens, parentheses, history, memory, and input changes within a calculator engine.

classes.name: ICalcDisplay
classes.description: An interface for calculator display callbacks, to be implemented by clients of the calculator engine.

methods.name: SetPrimaryDisplay
methods.description: Sets the primary display text and indicates if it is an error.

methods.name: SetIsInError
methods.description: Sets the error state of the display.

methods.name: SetExpressionDisplay
methods.description: Updates the expression display with tokens and commands.

methods.name: SetParenthesisNumber
methods.description: Sets the current count of open parentheses.

methods.name: OnNoRightParenAdded
methods.description: Handles the event when no right parenthesis is added.

methods.name: MaxDigitsReached
methods.description: Informs that maximum digit count has been reached.

methods.name: BinaryOperatorReceived
methods.description: Indicates that a binary operator has been received.

methods.name: OnHistoryItemAdded
methods.description: Handles the event when a history item is added.

methods.name: SetMemorizedNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of memorized numbers.

methods.name: MemoryItemChanged
methods.description: Handles change in a specific memory item.

methods.name: InputChanged
methods.description: Indicates that the input has changed.
